Tight End  
Michigan  
6-8, 265  
Albuquerque, N.M.  
Eldorado High School  
5th Round â 141st Overall**

**CAREER NOTES**  
Three-year letter winner at Michigan, playing in 33 games with 24 starts at tight endâ¦recorded 49 catches for 817 yards and four touchdowns in his careerâ¦earned U-M Athletic Academic Achievementâ¦switched to tight end from quarterback prior to sophomore season.

**2018 SEASON**  
Earned his third varsity letter, All-Big Ten third-team and All-Big Ten honorable mentionâ¦started all 13 games, catching 32 passes for 514 yards and two touchdownsâ¦23 of his 32 grabs resulted in first downs or touchdownsâ¦tied for the team lead with 10 receptions of 20 or more yardsâ¦had a career day with four catches for 95 yards against SMU (Sept. 15)â¦hauled in a touchdown on three catches for 32 yards vs. Nebraska (Sept. 22)â¦posted a career-high seven receptions for a personal-best 112 yards against Maryland (Oct. 6)â¦totaled 39 yards on two catches vs. Florida in the Chick-Fil-A Peach Bowl (Dec. 29).
